label: Button Fly
description: A button fly closes with a row of buttons concealed behind the fly placket, the traditional pre-zip method still chosen for its clean drape and heritage character. It has no metal to fail and lets the front of the trouser fall in a smoother line, at the cost of being slower to fasten. It is common on bespoke trousers and selvedge denim alike.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
